title: Ultra Hardcore by DWizard
description: A feature-rich datapack that aims to increase Minecraft's difficulty and turn the game into a true survival experience, by expanding it's progression and all of it's survival aspects.
body:
# Requirements
This datapack requires a resource pack to load its custom textures!
Link: https://modrinth.com/project/ultra-hardcore-resource-pack

Optifine is required for the custom mob textures to load! (You can still play the datapack without Optifine, but the new mobs won't have custom textures)
Link: https://optifine.net/home

# Features:
- expanded progression system (flint, copper, steel & blaze gold tier),
- expanded survival systems (wounds, nutrition, health scaling, frost, hydration & sanity),
- new mobs & mob difficulty scaling,
- stronger Wither & Ender Dragon,
- new armor & tools,
- new foods,
- all stews are now stackable, 
- 2 new utility blocks for forging,
- some structures,
- changes to farming,
- and more!

> All features of this datapack are described in detail on it's official wiki! A beginner guide is also available.


# Game design
While the player must overcome many new obstacles in the early game, they become easier to manage as the player progresses. The **post ending experience remains mostly the same**.

> All obstacles introduced by the datapack can be easily managed in the late game. For example, hydration is essentially auto-managed when the player obtains a hydrating helmet.

This datapack is highly **configurable**! Almost any feature you don't like can be disabled.

# Note
This datapack is currently in Beta and is actively recieving updates that fix bugs as I discover them.

When the datapack is close to ready for a first release I'll publish it on Planet Minecraft where people can leave their comments.
